source_review_note: The pinned Grossenbacher 2017 block records the exact fixed-universe label Hypochoeris radicata as SI and explicitly excludes conflicting species and among-population breeding-system variation. Primary literature under the standard orthographic form Hypochaeris radicata directly tests compatibility: Ortiz et al. 2006 classifies the species as self-incompatible after experiments on 205 plants across 21 populations, with occasional SC individuals treated as exceptions; Pico et al. 2004 independently finds selfing dramatically reduces seed set. No higher-taxon inference or autonomous-selfing proxy is used.
